svg.title: Illustrated planet of Bengaluru
svg.desc: Bengaluru civic core: 9449 building footprints, 4614 roads, 324 parks and 48 water bodies from OpenStreetMap mapped onto a small globe. Landmarks: Vidhana Soudha, Vikasa Soudha, Karnataka High Court, Cubbon Park, M. Chinnaswamy Stadium, Sree Kanteerava Indoor Stadium, Bangalore GPO, State Central Library, Government Museum, Visvesvaraya Museum, Freedom Park, Raj Bhavan Gardens.
